title: Component manifest: the self-description of a component as a distribution unit
description: The language-neutral canon of the self-description. The basis of "download = install": the installer reads this and merges the default wiring into the assembly manifest. Optional fields are absent when unused — writers never emit null. This schema pins local structure only; cross-referential rules (duplicate tool names, provider reachability, profile claims, event-type ownership) belong to assembly inspection.

runtime.description: Form: loaded in-process, or a separate process — an executable in any language, speaking one envelope JSON per line

entry.description: Entry: module path or executable path

inputs.description: Where events arrive; a port's events declare which types it accepts, ["*"] means accept-all (e.g. audit observers)

outputs.description: Where events leave; a port's events declare which types it may emit — "*" is not allowed, you cannot promise everything

events.description: Letter types this component brings, registered into the log at assembly time

defaultWiring.description: Wiring suggestions applied at install time; "self" refers to this component's future instance name

capabilities.description: Declared effect surface of the whole component (trust model: a trust record = content fingerprint + the granted surface). Absent = declares nothing = treated as the most dangerous.

implements.description: Standard port profiles this component claims; inspection verifies claims structurally, conformance exams verify them behaviorally

handleTimeoutMs.description: Per-delivery processing deadline in milliseconds; on expiry the kernel auto-cancels the delivery (the watchman trigger). Absent = no deadline; long-running components should set one.

concurrency.description: How many deliveries this component may handle AT ONCE. Absent or 1 = the mailbox as a queue drained one at a time, so the component may keep state between deliveries and block inside its handler without thinking about anyone else. More than one turns the mailbox into a work queue with that many workers, each holding its own instance — what a tool provider wants, since a model asking for three commands in one turn means them to run together. Only for components that keep NO state between deliveries, and it gives up FIFO: results come back in whatever order they finish.

prompt.description: One passage merged into the system prompt whenever this component is assembled — the component telling the model how to use it; the assembly may override per instance

tools.description: Tools this component provides, as neutral declarations; the kernel stamps each with its provider instance and the loop offers the collected list to the model

decision.description: Decision-class events must carry a reason, enforced by the log at its entry point. Absent = false.

description.description: One-line description of what this event means

schema.description: JSON Schema for this type's payload (the letter); when present the log validates payloads at the entry point — enforcement layer four

endpoint.description: "instance.port" — everything before the first dot is the instance

effectSurface.description: The shared effect vocabulary: what a tool call or a whole component may touch. Policies reason over this, never over names. Absent dimensions default to empty/false.

network.description: Network hosts it may reach; "*" = any

reversible.description: Whether its effects can be undone

admits.description: Set on a tool call's surface when the call INTRODUCES new code or instructions into the runtime (e.g. "components", "skills"). The trust gate keys on this marker — never on tool names. Stripped before the declaration goes to a provider, like the rest of the surface.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the tool's arguments, as offered to the provider

effects.description: Per-call effect surface; undeclared = treated as the most dangerous

async.description: Temporality — the fifth tool dimension: may this call run in the background. Metadata shaped like the effect surface, stripped before the declaration goes to a provider. Absent = never.
